register.labelZh: CHUCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: chuck it down 是英式非正式用語,可以生動地表示雨下得非常大。；你可以用 chuck somebody out 表示把某人趕走,也可以用 chuck something out 表示否決一個構思。；chuck something away 可以表示浪費金錢、好機會或多個月的努力。；chuck something in 或 chuck something up 可以用非正式方式表示辭掉工作或放棄課程。；售貨員可能會免費 chuck in 一件物品;感到不適的人則可能會 chuck up。
register.summaryEn: Chuck it down is a common informal British expression for rain that is falling very heavily. You can chuck a person out of a place or chuck out an idea that a group does not accept. Chuck something away can describe wasting money, a good chance or months of hard work. Chuck something in or chuck something up gives an informal way to talk about leaving a job or stopping a course. A seller may chuck in a free item, while somebody who feels ill may chuck up.
